scope: Installed household speaker composition and actual speaker wire audio/session modules
Codex session lifecycle, WebRTC capture/playback and interruption
Authenticated local Responses bridge, context handoff and deduplication
LivingConversation memory/context preparation, tool authorization and model routing
Pydantic tool registration, deferred namespace presentation, public research transport

differences: installer_wizard_cli.py outside active voice path; no replacement proposed

confirmed_findings.finding: Existing synchronous research action is removed when background research and contact model are available.
A new lookup receipt outside contact_receipts selects the work model for follow-up; tool registration alone does not keep the reply on Sol.
Initial memory recall and active context are already overlapped. Retain audience-scoped memory rather than bypassing it.
The local Responses bridge waits for a final core reply before emitting its response SSE. Delta events are currently not forwarded as spoken text.
Provider HTTP is asynchronous internally but the entire bounded SSE body is read into BytesIO before downstream parsing. Instrument network arrival inside this reader.
OfferedSpeech defaults interrupted=True and never establishes completed playback from speaker acknowledgements.
All assistant turn.done events set a shared completion event used by say(); pending speech is not correlated to a unique provider turn.
say() awaits provider completion, not the native sink playback barrier. Full physical playback remains unproven by these handles.
Non-text Telegram messages are rejected; voice note support is separate remaining integration work.

causality_limits: Playback observations are static code findings, not a reproduction proving the cause of the owner-reported lost audio.
The 8.65-second interval was in direct Codex mode without EVA deferred tools; it cannot be attributed to EVA tool discovery.
Direct and EVA timings are individual synthetic samples, not controlled distributions.
Body buffering does not itself explain all remote research latency; validation before speech is still required.

proposal.change: Separate routine lookup from durable research in the existing conversation action system.
implementation: Register a bounded structured public lookup descriptor and matching external action handler through runtime composition.
Keep list/get work status on existing local actions. Start with an explicit weather adapter using resolved public location, date and units; do not masquerade as a generic news search.
Extend explicit contact-model continuation policy for verified bounded lookup receipts so Sol handles both action selection and answer.
Reserve existing Astra durable worker for extensive research and ongoing work.
Retain identity, audience-scoped memory, tool result receipts, input/output limits, authority checks and usage recording.

proposal.change: Offer a small authorized core tool set directly at EVA provider boundary.
implementation: Do not inject Codex dynamicTools as a substitute for EVA registration.
Change admission envelope, provider projection and replay validation together; keep larger catalogs deferred.
Retest actual tool invocation because the earlier eager-handoff candidate made no tool call; schema validity alone is insufficient.

proposal.change: Repair per-answer speech delivery and interruption state.
implementation: Bind generated speech, queued PCM and native generation acknowledgements to a single delivery identity.
Distinguish provider finished, output drained, interrupted and unknown.
Use existing STOP/STOPPED barriers; stale turn completion must not release a newer pending answer.
Preserve accepted background work across barge-in while respecting explicit task cancellation.

proposal.change: Measure actual streamed boundaries and then optimize safe reply delivery.
implementation: Instrument headers, first SSE event, search lifecycle, first text, validated final result, first and last PCM, native playback acknowledgements.
Retain bounded metadata-only logging and avoid production asyncio debug payloads.
Do not stream unvalidated claims; allow early speech only at an explicitly validated boundary.
Treat result polling as a secondary optimization after the serial model/task overhead is removed.

proposal.change: Reuse the resulting core for additional channels.
implementation: Add Telegram voice-note ingress/egress with bounded audio and existing principal bindings.
Treat WhatsApp voice notes and live calls as separate channel capabilities requiring their own transport integration, not a switch on Telegram or WebRTC.

weather_source_candidate.limits: Validate location ambiguity, timezone, date range, bytes and structured fields; preserve source and observation time. Provider performance has not been measured in this audit.

proposed_cases: weather tomorrow and day after in different places
provider timeout, rate limit and malformed/oversize response
late old turn.done cannot complete new speech
second question while saved work completes
actual device full answer and STOP acknowledgement

proposed_acceptance_targets_not_guarante.method: Measure source EOF and outgoing microphone EOF separately; use actual audible/device playback where available; include failures, cold/warm state and source freshness. Small fixed acceptance set, not repeated success-only sampling.
